description.value: The Queensborough Library is a branch of the New Westminster Public Library, situated inside the Queensborough Community Centre on Ewen Avenue. It offers free public Wi-Fi, public computers, borrowing services, and regular community programming including employment services drop-ins. For a touring cyclist, it represents a welcoming public indoor stop with digital access in the Queensborough neighbourhood of New Westminster.
